This doesn't really work. These steps end up running in another conceptual thread. So the return values are lost.

You need to communicate back to the main thread through tasks.

You also need to actually start the parallel queue as otherwise it won't be executing its steps. See https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/infrastructure.html#starting-a-new-parallel-queue.
